text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, April 8 - Chittagong - 21 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 4 general cargo, 2 cement, 5 food grain, 2 tankers, 1 cement clinker, 2 other vessels. 30 Vessels due by 15/4 of which 11 containers, 11 general cargo, 1 cement, 1 fertiliser, 1 food grain, 1 car carrier, 2 tankers, 2 other vessels. No berthing delays.

MALAYSIA, April 9 - Port Klang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels berthed, 10 waiting with 1 day waiting time expected. Deep draft conventional wharf - 2 Vessels berthed, 2 berthing today, 2 waiting with 1 day waiting time expected. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 7 waiting with 10 days waiting time expected. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting with 1 day waiting time expected. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, 1 waiting with no delays. Deep draft conventional wharf - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays. Cement bulk terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays, Liquid bulk terminal - 1 vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays.

PAKISTAN, April 7 - Karachi - Seven vessels loading at berth (rice, mol), 3 container vessels loading/discharging at berth. 11 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, urea, sugar, phosphate). 3 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting to discharge (dap, jet, crude oil, hsd, containers). 3 Vessels awaiting orders. 3 Vessels due with the following delays expected, general cargo/containers 1-2 days, tankers 1 day, rice loader 4 days. Port Qasim - Two vessels loading at berth (rice, jute), 2 discharging at berth (wheat, fuel oil). 1 Fuel oil vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 crude oil vessel waiting at anchorage to load.

SIERRA LEONE, April 7 - Freetown - No labour problems. One scrap metal loader anchored. 5 Vessels due (1 container/vehicle discharger, 1 container discharger, 2 aid cargo dischargers), no delays expected. For security reasons vessels must endeavour to be in/out of port before 19.00 hrs.

SINGAPORE, April 8 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 12 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 14 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 7 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 7 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 2 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 28 Tankers berthed. Minimal delays at all terminals/ports/buoys.

SOUTH KOREA, April 8 - Inchon - 61 Vessels in port (40 berthed, 21 anchored) of which berthed, 8 logs, 7 general cargo, 5 cars, 5 containers, 2 corn, 2 steel, 2 logs, 1 granite, 1 h-beams, 1 talc, 1 pig iron, 1 molasses, 1 cotton seed meal, 1 coils, 1 pulp, 1 silica sand. Vessels anchored, 4 containers, 4 steel, 2 logs, 1 corn, 1 general cargo, 1 scrap, 1 paper, 1 copra, 1 wheat blending pellets, 1 palm oil, 1 soya bean meal, 1 raw sugar, 1 h-bea, 1 coils, approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Busan - 152 Vessels in port (39 berthed, 113 anchored including 56 laid-up) of which berthed, 24 general cargo, 9 containers, 4 scrap, 2 coal. 57 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Pohang - 48 Vessels in port (28 berthed, 20 anchored) of which berthed and discharging, 4 scrap, 2 coal, 2 structures, 2 billets, 2 pig-iron, 1 iron ore, 1 manganese, 1 pipes, 1 coils, 1 hot briquette iron. 20 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 3 days delay expected.

Ulsan - 21 Vessels in port (all berthed), of which discharging, 3 chemicals, 2 crude oil, 2 feed meal, 1 coal, 1 coils, 1 cement, 1 raw sugar, 1 wood-chips, 1 mono-ethyl glycol, 1 copper concentrate, 1 diesel oil. Vessels loading, 2 general cargo, 2 chemicals, 1 fertiliser, 1 ammonium sulphate, no berthing delays expected. Masan - Seven vessels in port (all berthed and all discharging), of which 3 scrap, 2 logs, 1 tapioca, 1 pig-iron, no berthing delays.

SRI LANKA, April 8 - Colombo - No labour problems. 16 Vessels loading at berth (10 containers, 2 vehicles, 4 essential services). 23 Discharging at berth (2 bagged sugar, 12 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bagged cement, 1 bulk clinker, 2 general cargo, 1 bagged tsp, 1 bagged onions, 2 vehicles). 11 Container vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 14 Vessels waiting to discharge (12 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 general cargo). 2 Vessels bunkering, 1 under repair, 3 dry-docked, 8 awaiting orders, 5 container vessels due with 24 hours delay expected for conventional/container vessels. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth.

TAIWAN, April 7 - Keelung - Seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 7 days, steel/iron ore 4 days, no delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 1 day, iron/coal 2 days (CSC berth), coal/scrap 3 days (public berth), steel 4 days. Taichung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 3-4 days, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel/others 1-2 days.
